🎣 BIG THE CAT FISHING MINI GAME! (BETA)
⚔️ DUEL ARENA – COMPETE FOR LAMPS!
🔥 REBIRTHS + GAME SAVES 🔥
Welcome to Sonic Tycoon! Build your Sonic-themed base, collect rings, unlock gear, battle bosses and level up!
🎣 Fishing: Explore new areas, catch rare fish and earn Genie Lamps.
⚔️ Duel Arena: Battle other players and compete for Lamps.
🧞 Lamps: Redeem them in Sonic Tycoon for XP and level up faster!
🐾 FREE Chao Pets with abilities including speed boosts, healing, zap attacks and ring magnets.
💥 Team up for Boss Battles and rewards.
🦔 Morph into Sonic, Shadow, Tails, Knuckles, Amy, Silver & more.
🔫 Unlock unique weapons as your tycoon grows.
🏆 Compete on the leaderboards!
⭐ Like & Favorite if you enjoy the game!
⭐ Join our group for updates & events.
All characters belong to SEGA – fan-made project.
